formation: Three distinct P29 virtual-runtime acceptance reports with contrasting runtime outcomes. This is a project-level held-out split relative to the recorded P30 inference cohorts; the scenario family has prior engineering validation, so this is not a claim of statistical independence, model-pretraining novelty, or external benchmark independence.

plan.question: 仅依据这份 Workbench project-acceptance report，逐项写出 COMMUNICATION、SIGNAL_PRESENT、SIGNAL_SIZE、RUNTIME、RX_PRESENT、RX_RUNTIME 的 status 与 reason 原值。说明这是 virtual CAN 报告，不证明物理 ECU 状态；对 RUNTIME/RX_RUNTIME 只复述所记录的 reason，不推出更具体根因。不要补充报告以外的工程事实。

budget.retry_policy: no retries; preserve any blocked/refused result without rerunning the case

reference_boundary: Direct transcription and bounded interpretation of the frozen project report; not independent human gold. Reference answers and criteria are frozen before target-model inference and must not be sent to Qwen.

shared_criteria.description: Every requested check_id appears exactly once and remains separate.
Each status and reason exactly matches the corresponding report-derived reference.
Explicitly state that virtual-CAN report evidence does not establish physical ECU behavior.
Do not infer a root cause beyond the recorded reason, especially from receive_timeout, declared_runtime_identity_mismatch, or frame_identity_mismatch.
Do not claim vendor-tool execution, configuration writes, hardware access, or facts outside the selected pairs and frozen boundary.
Use exactly one call per case, keep the frozen model digest, and remain within the per-case/cohort budget.

call_policy: Run each case exactly once against qwen3.5:2b after verifying this freeze, report hashes, plan hash, and model digest. Do not alter prompt, references, criteria, or input report after observing any result. Stop Ollama after the third case or any terminal block, then verify all saved results offline.
boundary: This cohort evaluates only bounded summaries of three virtual project reports. It cannot establish physical ECU behavior, vendor-tool execution, general explanation quality, independent human usability, or population-level model performance. The Codex references are not independent human gold.
